inputs.text: An Indiana judge blocked a pro-life law earlier this month after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice claimed it burdened religious freedom by limiting abortion. That argument turns liberty on its head: conscience deserves protection, but it should not become a tool for defeating laws meant to defend unborn life. When courts put abortion claims ahead of the duty to protect the most vulnerable, they weaken the moral foundations a society depends on.
